about: Every text of the repository (views, docs, tests, the expression language's own tests) that tess_ui.expr and the TEL adapter (tess_ui.tel) do not treat alike. tests/test_tel_parity.py fails on a difference that is not listed, and on a listed one that has gone, so this list only shrinks. `what`: compile (one refuses the text), names (they read different names) or result (a value or an error in a sample scope). `category`: function missing, semantics differ, TEL refuses the syntax, performance. Regenerate the candidates with `python tests/tel_parity.py`.

differences.reason: expr.py reads `_` as an ordinary name; TEL refuses a name starting with `_` everywhere except as a comprehension's throwaway variable, so a view state or param called `_` would have to be renamed. Only the sandbox tests of expr.py write it.
